sections.text: Introduction

This document out lines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

This document 
outlines 
the checks & schedule services CO% 
(2devices) & CO2% (2 devices) & O2% (3 devices) measuring devices.

These gases are the 
exhausts in the boiler, which their percentages must be measured by these 
devices to process them before getting out to the atmospheric air by the 
chimney.

by getting samples from 2 levels from the boiler 
and get into the analyzer in the device, their results appear on local 
indicating meter on the device and recorders at control room.

Enas Abdel Fattah, reviewed by eng. Ramadan Helmy, revised EDEPC quality control 
eng. Abdel Menem El-Emam, accepted by eng. Ali Abdel-Whab general director, and approved by eng. Mahmod Saker: 
Head Sector of Talkha PP.

Device Test

items:
Before calibration we must check the 
 mechanical zero of the indicating meter by switching off the FINOR, the needle 
 should be exactly on the extreme left mark of the scale [electrical zero] if 
 not, carefully correct by means of the set screw of the instrument.

Switch off the device and connect the Nitrogen 
 to the device after take off the sample from boiler

Switch on the device, wait to stabilizer and 
 check the reading still zero, if not correct the reading by 
 the potentiometer (zero point)

Switch off the device, remove the nitrogen and 
 connect the gas cylinder test to the device

Switch on the device, wait to stabilizer and 
 check the reading should 20 % Volt, If not correct the reading by the potentiometer (span point)

sections.text: CO% Device Test

Repeat the steps from 1 to 5 for 
 range 0 V to 1 V
O2% Device Test

items: Repeat the steps from 1 to 3

Switch off the device, remove the nitrogen and 
 connect the device to air

Switch on the device, wait to stabilizer and 
 check the reading should 5 VOL

If not correct the reading by the 
 potentiometer (span point)
